title: BrandingSetProperty - Tooling API
description: Represents a branding set property in the Theme panel in Experience Builder. This object is available in API version 40.0 and later.

PropertyName.description: The name of the branding set property, such as TextColor.

PropertyValue.description: The value of the branding set property, such as #333.
